analysis:
No supported finding. The PR scopes client stop strings to the answer channel. GPT-OSS uses the Harmony final message via ModelEOSPolicy.stopStringScope. Gemma 4 and <think> models use ReasoningStopScope. Native block engine (diffusion Gemma) requests carry no scope. It adds a .logprobs stream event, a .responseFormatCutOffByMaxTokens error mapped to HTTP 422, docs and changelog entries, and tests.

The replayed patches show an optional CBv2StopStringScope? (default nil) threaded through EngineV2Config, EngineV2Bridge, EngineV2Bridge+Submission (scope set at ~line 254, passed to the pump at ~948), EngineV2Bridge+Translation and the pump in EngineV2Bridge+Events. EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.matchedStopSequence replays the same scope to report the matched stop. The scope comes from model policy or the local prompt-prefix probe in MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine, not from a consumer-chosen field. It affects only generation termination and the reported stop-sequence usage metadata. Reservation and release paths, cacheScope and cacheSalt plumbing (T-041), E2E encryption (T-008), attestation and authorization are unchanged in the visible diffs.

Open items for the next pass, none established as vulnerabilities:
1. The libs/mlx, libs/mlx-swift and libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointers moved, and their contents were not supplied. They sit in TB-007 and the KV/prefix-cache path (T-041, T-028), so their diffs need review.
2. The StopHoldback, CBv2StopStringScope and ReasoningStopScope implementations, and the engine loop that honors request.stopStringScope, were not supplied. I could not verify that scoped matching fails safe. I also could not verify that a stop string spanning a scope boundary leaks nothing.
3. The .logprobs event is emitted in code outside the supplied evidence. Unit 17 suggests GLM response-format withholding may pass .logprobs through before validation. Check whether logprobs carry token text and are sealed on the coordinator leg (T-008, A-001).
4. matchedStopSequence re-ingests the text once per candidate, O(candidates × text), at terminal time. Check that the stop list is bounded by request validation.
5. About half the replayed source was omitted (156 of 326 units), and some patch excerpts were truncated, so coverage is incomplete.
